name: Diagonal Battle (Anti-Diagonal vs Vertical)
description: P0 has an anti-diagonal 3-in-a-row: (5,2), (4,3), (3,4). P0 wins by playing col 5 (piece falls to row 2, completing diagonal (2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2)). P1 also has a vertical 3-in-a-row at col 5 rows 3-5 and threatens the same col 5 for vertical win. Whoever plays col 5 first wins. Tests diagonal threat detection vs vertical threat detection.
